summary.headline: Astrological Questions 292–314
summary.text: Catalog entries 292–314 from a Venetian astrological codex, covering hearing and writing, letters and lawsuits, illness and death, stolen goods, sedition and civil wars, weather, earthquakes, honors, profit, marriage, childbearing, accidents, and death abroad. Cross-references cite Parisinus 2506, codex 6, and a work by Theodosius.
